attr.title: Geometry Wars 3: Dimensions
attr.desc: Native 32-bit ARM port of the Android version of Geometry Wars 3: Dimensions (1.3.0 Evolved with its controller-first console menus, or 1.0.0), running the original libgwnext.so engine through a custom Android-on-Linux loader (KMS/DRM, GLES2, FMOD). Adds an Options > Graphics page, offline achievements and R36S button prompts. You must supply your own copy of the game's APK and OBB.
attr.inst: Copy your game APK (or .xapk/.apkm) and its OBB (main.101.com.activision.gw3.dimensions.obb for 1.3.0, recommended; main.35 for 1.0.0) into this port's gw3/ folder, then launch. The engine and FMOD libraries are extracted from the APK on first run.
